integratorChecks: Applied the swarm's three documentation patches to integrator-owned files and ran npm run specs:check: 20 specifications validated, no drift.
acceptedDeviations: The swarm reported an out-of-process edit to a CONTRACT-owned core file by another swarm (optional authentication and nativeExtensions on the event descriptor). Additive and consistent with the profile, so it was kept and the affected schemas regenerated.

integratorChecks: Re-ran tests/connectors/registry-mcp/*.test.ts independently: 44 tests, 44 pass, 0 fail.
Grepped the whole module for eval, new Function, child_process, execSync, spawn and require: none present, so a registry listing naming a package or image cannot reach an execution path.
Read the client: publication is refused unless the deployment passes allowPublication explicitly, and it is off by default including for the official source constant.
acceptedDeviations: The brief asked for support catalog-only. The adapter genuinely implements discover, import and export, and the contract now defines catalog-only as implementing nothing, so the entry reports provider-backed with every unimplemented dimension marked unsupported individually. Accepted: the alternative would misreport the adapter's capabilities.
openForIntegrator: The client accepts baseUrl as an option defaulting to the official constant. Wiring MUST pass the base URL from an ApprovedDestination so it can never originate in caller input.
The public subregistry projection is empty unless the host supplies an explicit set of public identity digests; nothing is public by default and the host has no storage or UI for that set yet.
